craft_notes: Sthāyin: mutual rite — reciprocity. Rows: triple opening; mutual close. Rejected: smoothing kḷptāvato — killed: anomaly flagged, pair-sense kept. Read aloud: round dance.

lines: Co-risen with cause and fruit, three-shaped — plain, or set in form —
the two adore each other, face to face,
and by their sating draw bliss near.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāryahetusahotthatvāt traidhaṃ sākṣād athānyathā kḷptāvato mitho 'bhyarcya tarpyānandāntikatvataḥ

reads_against.argmap: mutual worship; bliss proximate by satisfying
